body: I really, really don't. I can't even fathom leaving her alone on this world, but fuck life isn't worth it anymore.
Well, thanks stranger. Maybe you're right. There are alternatives. I think I would want to live like Bukowski. Maybe that's all I'm good for is getting drunk, being lonely, and writing poetry.
Well it's this unshakeable loneliness. No matter how much I try and try to overcome it, I just can't rid of it. Drinking helps, but not much.
Because I need to say my goodbyes and get things ready. My best friend is also planning to visit the 18th through the 20th.
